sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco-based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. [1][2] Unlike a large language model (LLM), Jev does not generate natural-language text. It instead returns typed values together with ...

sources.title: Jev AI — Decisions at machine speed
sources.snippet: Jev AI is the first System One Model from TypeSafe AI: type-safe decisions in 70-500 ms, zero hallucinations, calibrated confidence. Founded by a ChatGPT co-inventor. Output tokens free, input from $0.042 per million.
